title.en: Chapter 25 — I Strike the Jolly Roger

sentences.ar: نزلت عالكابينة، وكان كل إشي مكسور ومقلوب.
sentences.en: I went down to the cabin, and everything was broken and overturned.

sentences.ar: لقيت قنينة روم، وجبتها لهاندز، وشربت أنا مي.
sentences.en: I found a bottle of rum, brought it to Hands, and drank water myself.

sentences.ar: وأكلت بسكوت، ولأول مرة من يومين، حسيت إني حي.
sentences.en: And I ate biscuit, and for the first time in two days, I felt alive.

sentences.ar: هاندز شرب نص القنينة، وقال: آه.
sentences.en: Hands drank half the bottle, and said: ah.
That is what I needed.
And I asked him: are you wounded?

sentences.ar: قال: اللي كان معي جرحني بفخدي.
sentences.en: He said: the one with me stabbed me in the thigh.
And he died.
And I did not.

sentences.ar: وبعدين قلت له: يا سيد هاندز، أنا هلق كابتن هالسفينة.
sentences.en: And then I said to him: Mr. Hands, I am the captain of this ship now.
And my first order: I take down this black flag.

sentences.ar: رحت عالسارية، ونزلت علم القراصنة، ورميته بالبحر.
sentences.en: I went to the mast, lowered the pirate flag, and threw it into the sea.
I said: God save the king!
And so much for Captain Silver!

sentences.ar: هاندز تطلع فيّ، وضحك ضحكة زغيرة.
sentences.en: Hands looked at me, and gave a small laugh.
He said: fine, Captain Hawkins.
And now what do you want to do?

sentences.ar: قلت: بدي أوصل السفينة للخليج الشمالي، وأوقفها عالشط.
sentences.en: I said: I want to take the ship to the north inlet, and beach her on the shore.

sentences.ar: لأنه ما بقدر أرجع للمرسى القديم، القتلة هناك.
sentences.en: Because I cannot go back to the old anchorage; the killers are there.

sentences.ar: قال هاندز: وإنت بتعرف تقود سفينة؟
sentences.en: Hands said: and do you know how to sail a ship?
I said: no.
He said: I do.
But I am wounded.

sentences.ar: إنت بتعطيني أكل وشراب ومنديل لجرحي.
sentences.en: You give me food and drink and a cloth for my wound.
And I say how to sail her.

sentences.ar: وعينه كانت بتتطلع فيّ بطريقة ما حبيتها.
sentences.en: And his eyes were looking at me in a way I did not like.
But I had no choice.

sentences.ar: وهيك صرنا اتنين نقود السفينة: أنا بإيدي، وهو بلسانه.
sentences.en: And so the two of us sailed the ship: I with my hands, he with his tongue.
Right a little.
Left a little.
Haul the rope.
Ease off.

sentences.ar: والسفينة سمعت، ومشت زي ما بدنا.
sentences.en: And the ship obeyed, and went as we wished.

sentences.ar: وشوي شوي، لفينا حول الجزيرة، ووصلنا عالشمال.
sentences.en: And little by little, we rounded the island, and reached the north.
And Hands sat, drinking, watching me.
And I knew he was thinking of something.
But I was very happy.

sentences.ar: لأني كنت قائد سفينة، وعمري أربعتعشر سنة.
sentences.en: Because I was the master of a ship, and I was fourteen years old.
